153:t_1:89.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「Whatever are you planning to do, $$ミネバ$$?」

153:t_1:90.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「I will speak with $$マーサ・ビスト・カーバイン$$ and ascertain her true intentions.」

153:t_1:94.en: ～ $$オーブ$$ Union, Official Residence, Conference Room ～

153:t_1:95.en:
$$カガリ$$
「...I see. Then show her in.」

153:t_1:96.en:
$$マーサ$$
「What did $$ミネバ・ザビ$$ say?」

153:t_1:97.en:
$$カガリ$$
「She says she will meet with you. I respect her decision.」

153:t_1:98.en:
$$マーサ$$
「What...! So $$オーブ$$ has been sheltering $$ミネバ・ザビ$$, the surviving child of the $$ザビ家$$!?」

153:t_1:100.en:
$$マーサ$$
「This is... a grave breach of trust toward the $$地球連邦$$! It cannot be tolerated!」

153:t_1:101.en:
$$マーサ$$
「As a private citizen, I will report this to the military!」

153:t_1:102.en:
$$カガリ$$
「$$マーサ・ビスト・カーバイン$$...!」

153:t_1:103.en:
$$マーサ$$
「You would do well not to try anything rash, Representative. My people have already infiltrated this official residence as well.」

153:t_1:104.en:
$$カガリ$$
「So your aim from the start was to abduct $$ミネバ$$ and crush $$オーブ$$!」

153:t_1:105.en:
$$マーサ$$
「If you hand over that little $$ジオン$$ girl quietly, I have no intention of using force on any of you. I leave that sort of thing to the military.」

153:t_1:106.en:
$$マーサ$$
「However, for the future relations between Earth and the Empire, the existence of $$オーブ$$ can only be an obstacle. Therefore, I will be taking appropriate measures.」

153:t_1:108.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Representative $$アスハ$$... It seems you have been poisoned by the logic of men.」

153:t_1:109.en:
$$マーサ$$
「People cannot live on ideals and pride alone. Allow me to make you realize that as well.」

153:t_1:113.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Together with $$アルベルト$$, take $$ミネバ・ザビ$$ into custody.」

153:t_2:4.en:
$$マーサ$$
「I'm glad to see you looking well, Your Highness. Allow me to offer a proper greeting for our reunion.」

153:t_2:6.en:
$$マーサ$$
「How were your days in $$オーブ$$? Did they make for a brief holiday, I wonder?」

153:t_2:7.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Heh heh... $$オードリー・バーン$$, was it? Even as an alias, it has a lovely ring.」

153:t_2:8.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「...Was this attack on $$オーブ$$ made with the consent of Chairman $$ローナン・マーセナス$$ as well?」

153:t_2:9.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Of course. Chairman $$ローナン$$ and I are working toward the same goal.」

153:t_2:11.en:
$$マーサ$$
「We will seal away $$ラプラスの箱$$. I understand Your Highness also left $$ネオ・ジオン$$ wishing for that.」

153:t_2:12.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Are you saying you have found where the Box is?」

153:t_2:13.en:
$$マーサ$$
「No... But we do know what its key is.」

153:t_2:15.en:
$$マーサ$$
「We will soon obtain the $$ユニコーン$$. Until then, the boy who pilots it will serve as its guardian.」

153:t_2:16.en:
$$マーサ$$
「You and he are no strangers, are you, Your Highness... $$バナージ・リンクス$$.」

153:t_2:18.en:
$$マーサ$$
「We are also aware that Dakar was the last place where the $$ラプラス・プログラム$$, which points to the Box's location, was disclosed.」

153:t_2:19.en:
$$マーサ$$
「We intend to obtain the $$ユニコーン$$ and, at the same time, get the next coordinate data out of $$バナージ・リンクス$$.」

153:t_2:20.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「I cannot imagine that boy would agree to such a scheme.」

153:t_2:21.en:
$$マーサ$$
「$$バナージ・リンクス$$... In just those ways, he has inherited the blood of the men of the $$ビスト家$$...」

153:t_2:23.en:
$$マーサ$$
「That boy's father is $$カーディアス・ビスト$$, who is also my brother.」

153:t_2:24.en:
$$マーサ$$
「An illegitimate child inheriting his foolish father's delusions... You have no idea how much trouble it causes us...」

153:t_2:25.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「$$バナージ$$ is... that gentleman's...」

153:t_2:26.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Would you not join forces with me, Your Highness?」

153:t_2:27.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「You want me to persuade $$バナージ$$?」

153:t_2:28.en:
$$マーサ$$
「I will not harm you. With you as a go-between, even relations with $$ネオ・ジオン$$ could be improved.」

153:t_2:29.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Then first, I want you to return $$マリーダ・クルス$$ to me.」

153:t_2:30.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Lieutenant $$マリーダ$$... Proto $$プルトゥエルブ$$ works under us of her own free will.」

153:t_2:32.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Yes, we did. Just as $$ネオ・ジオン$$ did... no, just as $$ジオン$$ did.」

153:t_2:33.en:
$$マーサ$$
「It was not we who created that pitiful creature.」

153:t_2:35.en:
$$マーサ$$
「All I did was release what lay within her and give her the chance for revenge.」

153:t_2:37.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Yes. Revenge on the world that made something like her, the world ruled by the logic of men...」

153:t_2:39.en:
$$マーサ$$
「$c will also arrive in $$オーブ$$ before long.」

153:t_2:40.en:
$$マーサ$$
「I will have her work there.」

153:t_3:4.en:
$$リディ$$
「Come with me, $$ミネバ$$! I came to save you!」

153:t_3:6.en:
$$リディ$$
「Quick, to the $$デルタプラス$$!」

153:t_3:7.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$, do you understand your position?」

153:t_3:8.en:
$$リディ$$
「I do, and that's why I'm doing this! You're the ones who ought to know what happens if you kill $$ローナン・マーセナス$$'s son!」

153:t_3:10.en:
$$リディ$$
「Just who are you people! Attacking $$オーブ$$ like that and abducting $$ミネバ$$!」

153:t_3:11.en:
$$リディ$$
「Cozying up to $$クロノ$$ and wagging your tails at the $$サイデリアル$$ while you're at it!?」

153:t_3:12.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「Managing the Box is also a matter for the $$ビスト家$$ itself! Don't meddle in another family's affairs!」

153:t_3:13.en:
$$リディ$$
「What are you saying at a time like this...!?」

153:t_3:14.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「$$バナージ・リンクス$$, who guards the key to the Box, is a child my father, the former head $$カーディアス・ビスト$$, had with his mistress.」

153:t_3:15.en:
$$リディ$$
「$$バナージ$$ is... a Vist...」

153:t_3:16.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「No matter that you are a member of the $$マーセナス家$$ and its heir, I must ask you not to interfere with us any further.」

153:t_3:18.en:
$$リディ$$
「...Do whatever you want with the Box, the $$ユニコーン$$, and $$バナージ$$! But her, I'm taking back!」

153:t_3:19.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Once you take me out of here, what do you intend to do then?」

153:t_3:20.en:
$$リディ$$
「We can think about that after we get out of here!」

153:t_3:21.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「What is it you want to protect? Me as a person, or the secret of $$ラプラスの箱$$? Or perhaps your family's honor...」
